scene_text.text: Candid handheld phone snapshot taken indoors from behind him at shoulder height two metres away: he stands shirtless in an open balcony doorway, both hands on a black wrought-iron railing, arms reaching down and slightly outward, the hand at picture-left curled over the top rail, the other draped over it with the wrist bent. His head is turned away from the camera, the face about 50 degrees to picture-left of straight ahead, chin a little lowered, so only his left ear and the outer edge of his left cheek show. He wears a black baseball cap backwards, its brim over his nape at picture-right, and wide heather-grey fleece sweatpants with a gathered waistband and back patch pockets; his janeu crosses his bare back from his left shoulder to his right hip, his silver chain at his nape. The open glass doors at both edges faintly reflect his forearms; a grey-taupe curtain hangs at the right edge. Opposite: a salmon tiled facade, grey stucco, closed white louvred shutters and an iron balcony; a small white bistro table with trailing plants at picture-right. Soft overcast daylight, muted natural colour, the facade softly blurred, fine grain, slightly off-centre. Square 1:1 frame.
